SELECT SUM(sd.units) FROM sales_daily sd JOIN products p ON sd.sku = p.sku JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE s.lead_time_days > 30
SELECT SUM(sd.units) FROM sales_daily sd JOIN products p ON sd.sku = p.sku JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE s.lead_time_days > 30

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.sku = p.sku AND w.city = 'Monterrey') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_daily sd WHERE sd.sku = p.sku AND sd.day >= '2026-09-01' AND sd.day <= '2026-09-30' AND sd.units > 0)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) FROM products p JOIN sales_daily sd ON sd.sku = p.sku WHERE sd.day >= '2026-09-01' AND sd.day <= '2026-09-30' AND sd.units > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.sku = p.sku AND w.city = 'Monterrey')
SELECT AVG(unit_cost) FROM products WHERE category = (SELECT category FROM products WHERE critical GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, category LIMIT 1)
SELECT AVG(unit_cost) FROM products WHERE category = (SELECT category FROM products WHERE critical GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, category LIMIT 1)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku)
FROM products p
JOIN sales_daily s ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE p.critical = TRUE
  AND s.day >= '2026-08-01' AND s.day < '2026-09-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sales_daily s2
      WHERE s2.sku = p.sku
        AND s2.day >= '2026-09-01' AND s2.day < '2026-10-01'
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.critical = TRUE AND p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM sales_daily WHERE day >= '2026-08-01' AND day < '2026-09-01') AND p.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM sales_daily WHERE day >= '2026-09-01' AND day < '2026-10-01')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.sku) FROM stock s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE w.city = 'Ciudad de Mexico' AND s.on_hand > 0 AND s.on_hand < 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku) FROM products p JOIN stock s ON p.sku = s.sku WHERE p.unit_cost > 500 AND s.on_hand > 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku)
FROM products p
JOIN stock s ON p.sku = s.sku
WHERE p.unit_cost > 500
  AND s.on_hand > 0
SELECT s.name FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.sku = (SELECT sku FROM sales_daily GROUP BY sku ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC, sku LIMIT 1)

SELECT s.name
FROM suppliers s
JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
WHERE p.sku = (
    SELECT sku
    FROM sales_daily
    GROUP BY sku
    ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC, sku
    LIMIT 1
)
